name: luyen-luat-video
description: Video giới thiệu Luyện Luật (TikTok 9:16, 60 fps) dựng bằng Remotion

scripts.render: npm run storyboard && remotion render Main out/gioi-thieu-dang-tiktok.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:nhap: npm run music && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/gioi-thieu-dang-tiktok.mp4 -i public/music/nhac-nhap.wav -filter_complex "[1:a]volume=0.8[m];[0:a][m]amix=inputs=2:normalize=0[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest out/gioi-thieu-nhac-nhap.mp4
